name: orders
description: One row per order or cart (header). Use it for order counts, revenue totals, average order value, when orders happen (day, week, month, hour, weekday), and for open or abandoned carts.

columns.name: order_month
columns.desc: date, first day of the month, IST

columns.name: order_week
columns.desc: date, Monday of the week, IST

notes: The order_* columns are NULL for pending carts.

name: order_items
description: One row per product per order (line items, already joined to the order's status and dates). Use it for product and category sales: units sold, product or category revenue, what is bought together, never-sold or best-selling products.

name: products
description: The menu. Use it for prices, ratings, categories, descriptions and ingredients of menu items, and for finding items that were never sold (together with order_items).

name: customers
description: One row per customer (anonymised, no names or emails). Use it for customer counts, top spenders, repeat or new customers, sign-ups, locations, and customers' likes, dislikes and allergies.
